reason: Re-recorded: the coordination pass reads each Component's pods as the cache's own objects (query.ListCachedOMENativePodsByName), so the cache copies no pod for it. pods-copied 4,000 to 0 at engine/4000x1, 1,280 to 0 at 160x8, 1,000 to 0 at 1000x1, 24 and 44 to 0 on the prefill/decode shapes; the allocations fall by the copies' share (44,716 to 718 at 4000x1) and the bytes by the copied fields (15.7 to 9.5 MB; the list's own array of pods stays). The pods come from the cache stand-in through the OMENative pod index; the replica and the endpoints behind the split are read live from memory, so the apiserver's decode is not in the count.
